name: Shiphrah
bio: Shiphrah is one of two midwives who attended the Hebrew women in Egypt. Pharaoh ordered that every son born to a Hebrew woman be killed, but Shiphrah and her fellow midwife Puah, fearing God, refused to obey, and let the baby boys live. When Pharaoh confronted them, they cleverly answered that Hebrew women gave birth too quickly for the midwives to arrive in time — and God dealt well with them, giving them households of their own (Exodus 1:15-21).
